content: Blinkit shifted to inventory-led model through 2025; ~80% of Blinkit NOV inventory-led in Q2 FY26; Eternal consolidated revenue Q2 FY26 ~Rs13,590 cr (+183% YoY); company said YoY not like-for-like; Hyperpure revenue fell ~31% YoY due to the shift. Zomato renamed Eternal Ltd effective 20 Mar 2025; NSE/BSE symbol ZOMATO->ETERNAL from 9 Apr 2025.
